# crumbkit's schemas

These files are copies of `crates/crumbkit/schemas/commands-list-v1.json`,
`schemas-list-v1.json`, `schemas-show-v1.json` and `failure-v1.json` from
crumbkit at commit
`a85fa49c767a4313bbfa3261b84c4f6b4cbc73c1`, the 0.1.1 release and the commit
that `scripts/install-test-tools.sh` installs shelf and reading from. They
move with that commit.
